title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions every artifact schema references by $ref (docs/project-definition.md §Artifact schemas; STD-006). Not an artifact itself. Changes after M1 need an ADR.

production_id.description: p-NNNN for a production; t-<slug> for a test. tests/test_schemas.py holds this pattern equal to the one in manifest.schema.json.

hex_color.description: Lowercase #rrggbb, so one color has one spelling.

dimension.description: Creative dimensions a style can belong to (docs/project-definition.md §Style library). Sound is deferred; adding it needs an ADR. style_id and style_ref repeat these names; tests/test_schemas.py holds them equal.

style_ref.description: <style_id>@<version>: one exact version of one style.

module_id.description: <group>/<name> of a style module in blender/lib/, e.g. shaders/toon_ramp.

narration.description: The narration line for this beat or shot, or null for none. Audio-ready (docs/project-definition.md §Scope).

sound_cues.description: Audio-ready (docs/project-definition.md §Scope). offset_s is relative to the start of the beat or shot that holds the cue.
